specification:
Prudentia Vimeo video-on-demand workload (SIGCOMM '24, Table 1: BBR, 2 flows, max 14 Mbps, 7 bitrates up to 4K).
1. Open the Vimeo embed player for video <secret>video_id</secret> (reference video: Big Buck Bunny) with muted autoplay.
2. Wait briefly for the player to load and playback to start.
3. Keep the video playing for <secret>watch_seconds</secret> seconds (Prudentia runs 600 s).
